backlog.spec: Replace binary Morgan bits with count-based fingerprints using gen.GetCountFingerprintAsNumPy (radius 2, 2048 bits). Keep the random forest unchanged.
backlog.title: Count Morgan fingerprints

backlog.spec: Featurize with all RDKit Descriptors.descN (Descriptors.CalcMolDescriptors), replace NaN/inf with 0 and clip extremes. Use the RF on these descriptors alone.
backlog.title: RDKit 2D descriptors with RF

backlog.spec: Concatenate RDKit 2D descriptors (cleaned) with count Morgan fingerprints (radius 2, 1024 bits) and fit the RF with max_features 0.2.
backlog.title: Descriptors plus count Morgan concatenated

backlog.spec: Replace RF with LGBMRegressor (n_estimators 500, learning_rate 0.03, num_leaves 15, subsample 0.8, subsample_freq 1, colsample_bytree 0.3, min_child_samples 10, random_state seed, n_jobs 8) on RDKit descriptors plus count Morgan.
backlog.title: LightGBM on descriptors+counts

backlog.spec: Use CatBoostRegressor (iterations 800, depth 6, lr 0.05, l2_leaf_reg 5, random_seed seed, thread_count 8, verbose 0) on cleaned RDKit descriptors plus MACCS keys.
backlog.title: CatBoost on descriptors

backlog.spec: Convert train_y to normalized ranks (scipy.stats.rankdata/ n) before fitting, since the metric is Spearman. Predict with the same model.
backlog.title: Rank-transform target

backlog.spec: Swap RandomForestRegressor for ExtraTreesRegressor (500 trees, max_features 0.3, min_samples_leaf 1) on the current features.
backlog.title: ExtraTrees instead of RF

backlog.spec: Append the 167 MACCS keys (rdkit.Chem.MACCSkeys.GenMACCSKeys) to the Morgan bits as features for the RF.
backlog.title: MACCS keys addition

backlog.spec: Add count atom-pair fingerprints (rdFingerprintGenerator.GetAtomPairGenerator, fpSize 2048) to the features, concatenated with Morgan counts, for the RF.
backlog.title: Atom-pair and torsion counts

backlog.spec: Train separate RFs on Morgan counts, atom-pair counts, and RDKit descriptors; average the rank-normalized predictions of the three.
backlog.title: Feature-bagged ensemble of RF on different fingerprints

backlog.spec: Set MIN_SAMPLES_LEAF=3 and MAX_FEATURES=0.2 to smooth predictions; noisy target may benefit.
backlog.title: Min samples leaf 3

backlog.spec: Use Morgan radius 3 with FCFP-style feature invariants (GetMorganGenerator with atomInvariantsGenerator=rdFingerprintGenerator.GetMorganFeatureAtomInvGen()) counts, 2048 bits.
backlog.title: Larger radius Morgan with feature invariants

backlog.spec: Replace RF with sklearn SVR using a precomputed Tanimoto (minmax) kernel on count Morgan fingerprints, C=5, epsilon 0.1. Compute kernel with numpy.
backlog.title: SVR with Tanimoto kernel

backlog.spec: Use KernelRidge with precomputed minmax Tanimoto kernel on count Morgan fingerprints, alpha=1.0; predict on test kernel.
backlog.title: Gaussian process / kernel ridge Tanimoto

backlog.spec: Average rank-normalized predictions of the RF on descriptors+counts and a Tanimoto-kernel ridge model.
backlog.title: Blend RF and Tanimoto KRR

backlog.spec: Use LightGBM with objective huber (alpha 1.0) on standardized y, with descriptors plus counts, to reduce outlier influence.
backlog.title: Log/standardize target with Huber loss GBM

backlog.spec: Drop fingerprint columns with fewer than 5 nonzero molecules in the training set before fitting the RF; this reduces noise bits.
backlog.title: Remove low-variance features

backlog.spec: Canonicalize molecules by keeping the largest fragment (rdMolStandardize.LargestFragmentChooser) and neutralizing before featurization.
backlog.title: Salt stripping and largest fragment

backlog.spec: Increase N_TREES to 1000 and use max_features 'sqrt'-like 0.1 for decorrelation.
backlog.title: Seed-averaged RF with more trees

backlog.spec: Use XGBRegressor (n_estimators 600, max_depth 4, learning_rate 0.03, subsample 0.8, colsample_bytree 0.3, min_child_weight 3, n_jobs 8, random_state seed) on cleaned descriptors plus MACCS.
backlog.title: XGBoost on descriptors

backlog.spec: Inside fit_predict fit a quick RF on descriptors, keep the top 100 features by importance, then refit final RF on those plus count Morgan bits.
backlog.title: Select top descriptors by RF importance

backlog.spec: Use a compact set: MolLogP, TPSA, MolWt, HBD, HBA, RotatableBonds, aromatic rings, fraction sp3, charge counts, plus MACCS keys; fit RF with min_samples_leaf 2. Clearance depends strongly on lipophilicity.
backlog.title: Crippen/logP and TPSA focused small feature set

backlog.spec: Average rank-normalized predictions of RF, LightGBM and CatBoost, all on descriptors plus count Morgan features.
backlog.title: Stacked ensemble RF+LGBM+CatBoost

backlog.spec: Transform y using scipy.stats.norm.ppf of rank/(n+1) before fitting regressors, giving Gaussian target.
backlog.title: Pairwise-rank-friendly target: quantile-normal transform

backlog.spec: Apply np.log1p to count Morgan features and use a ridge-like model (sklearn Ridge alpha 10) blended 30% with the RF.
backlog.title: Morgan counts with log1p

backlog.spec: Standardize cleaned descriptors (QuantileTransformer) and fit 5 sklearn MLPRegressor (hidden 256,64, alpha 1e-2, early_stopping, different seeds); average predictions.
backlog.title: Small MLP ensemble on descriptors

backlog.spec: ExtraTreesRegressor with 800 trees, max_features 0.3, min_samples_leaf 2 on descriptors plus MACCS keys.
backlog.title: Bagged ExtraTrees on descriptors+MACCS

backlog.spec: Add rdReducedGraphs.GetErGFingerprint (315-dim) to descriptors and Morgan counts for the RF.
backlog.title: ErG and pharmacophore 2D fingerprints

backlog.spec: Compute Murcko scaffold counts in train and pass sample_weight=1/sqrt(count) to RF fit so large scaffold clusters do not dominate.
backlog.title: Scaffold-aware sample weights

backlog.spec: Concatenate Morgan count radius 1 (1024 bits) and radius 3 (2048 bits) into one feature set for the RF.
backlog.title: Larger Morgan fpSize with chirality off, radius 1 mix

backlog.spec: In fit_predict, replace y with a rank-based normal score before fitting the kernel ridge: r = scipy.stats.rankdata(y)/(len(y)+1); yt = scipy.stats.norm.ppf(r). Center yt, fit KernelRidge(alpha=1.0) on it with the existing minmax kernel, and return predictions (ranks only matter for Spearman, so no inverse transform).
backlog.title: Quantile-normal target transform for KRR

backlog.spec: Change KernelRidge alpha from 1.0 to 0.3 in fit_predict, keeping everything else the same. Minmax kernel on count Morgan is fairly smooth, so less regularization may help. Pure hyperparameter change.
backlog.title: Tune KRR alpha lower

backlog.spec: Compute count atom-pair fingerprints with rdFingerprintGenerator.GetAtomPairGenerator(fpSize=2048) GetCountFingerprintAsNumPy. Build K = 0.5*minmax_kernel(Morgan) + 0.5*minmax_kernel(AtomPair) for train-train and test-train, and fit KernelRidge(alpha=1.0) on the combined kernel as before.
backlog.title: Sum of Morgan and atom-pair minmax kernels

backlog.spec: Compute RDKit descriptors with the existing descriptors() function, apply sklearn QuantileTransformer(output_distribution='normal') fit on train, then build an RBF kernel exp(-gamma*d^2) with gamma=1/(n_features*2). Use K = 0.5*K_minmax + 0.5*K_rbf in KernelRidge(alpha=1.0, precomputed).
backlog.title: Add RBF descriptor kernel to Tanimoto kernel

backlog.spec: Fit the existing KRR predictions plus a LightGBM regressor (n_estimators=400, learning_rate=0.03, num_leaves=15, colsample_bytree=0.3, subsample=0.8, subsample_freq=1, min_child_samples=10, random_state=seed, n_jobs=8) on cleaned RDKit descriptors. Rank-normalize each model's test predictions (scipy.stats.rankdata) and average with weights 0.7 KRR and 0.3 LGBM.
backlog.title: Blend KRR with descriptor LightGBM

backlog.spec: Add a helper that parses each SMILES, keeps the largest fragment with rdkit.Chem.rdMolStandardize.LargestFragmentChooser().choose(mol), and uses that mol in the featurize function. Everything else is unchanged. Falls back to the original mol on exception.
backlog.title: Strip salts and keep largest fragment

backlog.spec: Replace KernelRidge with sklearn.svm.SVR(kernel='precomputed', C=3.0, epsilon=0.1) fit on minmax_kernel(Xtr,Xtr) with y standardized (z-score); predict from minmax_kernel(Xte,Xtr). Return the predictions.
backlog.title: SVR on precomputed minmax kernel

backlog.spec: After computing each minmax kernel matrix K (train-train and test-train), apply an elementwise power K**2 (still PSD by Schur product) before KernelRidge with alpha=0.3. This sharpens similarity to emphasize near neighbours, which often helps on unseen scaffolds.
backlog.title: Kernel power sharpening

backlog.spec: Make featurize take a radius parameter. Compute minmax kernels for Morgan count radius 1, 2, and 3 (2048 bits each), average the three train-train matrices and the three test-train matrices, and fit KernelRidge(alpha=1.0) on the average.
backlog.title: Multi-radius kernel averaging

backlog.spec: Pick KRR alpha inside fit_predict by inner 5-fold CV over alpha in [0.1,0.3,1,3] on the training kernel matrix, using Spearman on held-out folds (random KFold with seed). Precompute the full train kernel once and slice it. Refit with the best alpha on all training data and predict.
backlog.title: Gaussian process with learned noise via marginal likelihood

backlog.spec: Keep the minmax Tanimoto kernel on Morgan counts but change KernelRidge alpha from 1.0 to 0.3. Nothing else changes. This tests whether the model is over-regularized.
backlog.title: Lower KRR alpha

backlog.spec: Compute K = minmax_kernel(Xtr,Xtr) and the test kernel, then raise both elementwise to the power 2 (K**2) before KernelRidge with alpha=0.5. Elementwise powers of a PSD Gram matrix remain PSD (Schur product). This sharpens similarity toward close neighbors.
backlog.title: Kernel power sharpening

backlog.spec: Add a helper that parses each SMILES, uses rdkit.Chem.rdmolops.GetMolFrags(asMols=True) to keep the fragment with the most heavy atoms, and returns the mol. Use it in featurize so the fingerprints reflect only the parent molecule. Keep the rest of the pipeline unchanged.
backlog.title: Strip salts, keep largest fragment

backlog.spec: Fit the incumbent KRR and also a LightGBM (400 trees, lr 0.03, 15 leaves, colsample 0.3, subsample 0.8, seed=seed, n_jobs=8) on cleaned RDKit descriptors from descriptors(). Convert each prediction vector to ranks via scipy.stats.rankdata, normalize to 0-1, and return 0.7*KRR+0.3*LGBM.
backlog.title: Blend KRR with descriptor LightGBM by rank averaging

backlog.spec: Using the minmax kernel K on the training set, choose the KRR alpha by an internal eigendecomposition: compute eigh(K), then for alphas in [0.05,0.1,0.2,0.5,1,2] compute leave-one-out residuals in closed form (e_i = [(K+aI)^-1 y]_i / [(K+aI)^-1]_ii) and pick the alpha with the lowest LOO MSE. Fit the final model with that alpha.
backlog.title: Gaussian process marginal-likelihood alpha selection

backlog.spec: Average two kernels: the minmax kernel on raw Morgan counts and the Tanimoto (minmax on 0/1) kernel on binarized Morgan features of radius 3. Use KernelRidge alpha=1.0 on the averaged kernel. This mixes count-sensitive and presence-based similarity.
backlog.title: Log1p count Morgan with kernel on binary+count mix

backlog.spec: Train 10 KernelRidge models (alpha=0.7), each on a random 60% subset of Morgan columns, drawn with np.random.RandomState(seed). Compute the minmax kernel on only those columns, predict, and average the 10 predictions. This adds diversity to the kernel via random-subspace regularization.
backlog.title: Bagged KRR ensemble with feature subsampling

backlog.spec: In fit_predict, change the final blend from 0.7/0.3 to 0.6*mean(tree preds)+0.4*rank(ridge), and set Ridge alpha to 30. Keep everything else unchanged. Ridge on log1p Morgan counts was a replicated gain, so check whether more weight or stronger regularization helps.
backlog.title: Tune Ridge blend weight and alpha

backlog.spec: Add a second Ridge member (alpha 30) fit on a QuantileTransformer(output_distribution='normal', n_quantiles=200) transform of the descriptor+ErG columns (all columns before the last N_BITS), fit on the training data only. Blend as 0.65*tree mean + 0.2*rank(Morgan ridge) + 0.15*rank(descriptor ridge). Gives a smooth, different inductive bias.
backlog.title: Second linear member on descriptors+ErG

backlog.spec: Add a helper clean(smiles) that parses each SMILES, uses rdkit.Chem.rdmolops.GetMolFrags(asMols=True) and keeps the fragment with the most heavy atoms, returns a canonical SMILES string (fall back to the original if parsing fails). Apply it to train and test SMILES at the top of fit_predict before all featurization.
backlog.title: Strip salts and keep largest fragment

backlog.spec: Add 1024-bit count topological torsion fingerprints (rdFingerprintGenerator.GetTopologicalTorsionGenerator(fpSize=1024), GetCountFingerprintAsNumPy) and use them in the Ridge member only, by concatenating log1p(torsion counts) with log1p(Morgan counts) before the Ridge fit. Tree members stay unchanged.
backlog.title: Topological torsion count block for ridge

backlog.spec: Wrap the three tree models in a loop of 3 outer repeats with different seeds (seed, seed+1, seed+2), using LightGBM colsample 0.3 and CatBoost rsm 0.2 as now, and average the rank predictions over repeats. Reduces variance in the ensemble without changing model types. Reduce CatBoost to 300 iterations to stay within time.
backlog.title: Feature-bagged rank-average of seeds

backlog.spec: Replace the Ridge input with log1p of Morgan count fingerprints at radius 3 with 4096 bits (separate generator, computed inside fit_predict) and alpha 20. Tests whether richer environments help the linear member, since the ridge member gave a replicated gain.
backlog.title: Kernel PCA-free: Morgan feature hashing with folded counts of radius 0-1 for ridge

backlog.spec: Replace the LightGBM member with LGBMRegressor using objective='huber' removed and instead use a lambdarank-free approach: fit LGBMRegressor with the rank target but with extra_trees=True, num_leaves 7, n_estimators 1000, learning_rate 0.02, colsample_bytree 0.2. Extra-randomized shallow boosting adds diversity and regularization.
backlog.title: Rank-based pairwise-friendly LightGBM objective

backlog.spec: Inside fit_predict, compute 3-fold GroupKFold out-of-fold rank predictions (groups from Murcko scaffold via MurckoScaffold.MurckoScaffoldSmiles) for each of the four members (RF, LGBM, CatBoost, Ridge), then fit non-negative least squares (scipy.optimize.nnls) of y on the OOF ranks, normalize the weights to sum 1, and use them for the final blend of the full-fit predictions. Reduce CatBoost iterations to 300 for time.
backlog.title: Target-aware stacking via inner CV weights

backlog.spec: Add a fifth member: a KNeighborsRegressor(n_neighbors=10, weights='distance', metric='precomputed') using distance = 1 - minmax_kernel on Morgan count features (the existing minmax_kernel helper), trained on the rank target. Blend it at 15% by rank, reducing the tree mean weight accordingly (0.55 trees, 0.3 ridge... keep ridge 0.3, kNN 0.15). Local-neighbor diversity that is different from trees and ridge.
backlog.title: Add Mordred-like fragment counts (fr_ descriptors) with Morgan radius 1 binary into a kNN member

backlog.spec: In fit_predict, first fit a quick RF (200 trees, oob_score=True) on the features, compute out-of-bag predictions, and remove the 5% of training molecules with the largest absolute OOB rank residual from the training set for all members (including Ridge). Tests whether label noise in clearance data hurts.
backlog.title: Noise-robust training: drop extreme-residual molecules

backlog.spec: Wrap the three tree models in fit_predict so each is trained on 3 different random 85% subsamples of training rows (seeds derived from seed), and average the rank predictions across the subsamples before the existing rank averaging. Ridge stays as is. This decorrelates members through data bagging.
backlog.title: Seed-bagged ensemble with bootstrap subsets

backlog.spec: Change the final blend to 0.6 * mean tree ranks + 0.4 * ridge rank, and Ridge alpha from 10.0 to 3.0. Single edit of two constants in the last lines of fit_predict.
backlog.title: Tune Ridge blend weight to 0.4 and alpha 3

backlog.spec: Compute MACCS keys (rdkit.Chem.MACCSkeys.GenMACCSKeys) for train and test as float arrays. Concatenate them to the log1p Morgan counts used by the Ridge (not the tree models), with standard scaling of the MACCS columns by dividing by 2, and fit the Ridge on the combined matrix.
backlog.title: Add MACCS block to Ridge input only

backlog.spec: Replace the LGBMRegressor with LGBMRanker is awkward; instead add a fourth tree member: LightGBM with objective='huber' is already tried, so use LGBMRegressor with objective='quantile' alpha=0.5, n_estimators 600, learning_rate 0.03, num_leaves 7, colsample_bytree 0.2, min_child_samples 15, on the same features and rank target. Include it in the rank average.
backlog.title: Rank-pairwise LightGBM (lambdarank-style) member

backlog.spec: Inside fit_predict, do a quick 5-fold inner out-of-fold prediction with a RF (150 trees, max_features 0.2) on the full feature matrix, compute residuals against the rank target, and drop the 5% of training molecules with the largest absolute residual before fitting all final models and the Ridge.
backlog.title: Drop noisy training molecules

backlog.spec: Add rdkit descriptors from rdkit.Chem.rdMolDescriptors: CalcAUTOCORR2D (192 dims), and BCUT via Descriptors.BCUT2D (8 dims) as another feature block, after cleaning with nan_to_num, and hstack it between ErG and Morgan. Make sure the Ridge still uses only the last N_BITS columns.
backlog.title: Extra descriptors: Mordred-like autocorrelation and BCUT

backlog.spec: After computing the ranks of each member prediction, replace each with 0.8*own + 0.2*mean of all members before blending. Also weight the ridge at 0.3 as before. A small regularizing change on the ensemble; it should be a few lines in the loop.
backlog.title: Monotone smoothing: shrink member predictions toward consensus

backlog.spec: Add a member: sklearn MLPRegressor (hidden 128, alpha 1.0, early_stopping True, max_iter 300, random_state seed) on QuantileTransformer(output_distribution='normal') of descriptors+ErG columns (the first columns before Morgan, n = Xtr.shape[1]-N_BITS), averaged over 3 seeds. Blend as a 15% rank-weight, reducing tree weight accordingly (tree 0.55, ridge 0.3, mlp 0.15).
backlog.title: Random-projection MLP member on ErG+descriptors

backlog.spec: Add a separate RF member (500 trees, max_features 0.2) trained on rdFingerprintGenerator.GetRDKitFPGenerator(maxPath=6, fpSize=2048) count fingerprints concatenated with descriptors+ErG. Include its rank predictions in the tree rank average as a fourth member.
backlog.title: Mixed-fingerprint feature-bagged RF with Avalon and RDKit topological FP

incumbent.description: Add 315-dim ErG pharmacophore fingerprints between the RDKit descriptors and Morgan counts, so the tree models see them and the Ridge still uses the trailing Morgan block.

memo:
Helped: target handling and, above all, ensembling diverse members. The rank target gave 0.5286/0.5252 (replicated). The rank-averaged RF+LightGBM+kernel ensemble reached 0.5083. A 30% Ridge member on log1p Morgan counts gave 0.4922/0.4939 (replicated). ErG pharmacophore features gave the incumbent, 0.4745 (1 run only, a 0.0186 gain, about 2.7 noise sd).
Did not help: single tree models (ExtraTrees 0.6287/0.5571, RF 0.5564, LightGBM 0.5442), SVR 0.5699, MLP 0.5515, scaffold weights 0.5477, Gaussian quantile target 0.5289. Recent additions were flat or worse: CatBoost 0.4745, kernel ridge member 0.4787, atom-pair counts 0.4777, kNN 0.4812, NNLS blend 0.4782, torsion counts 0.4739, RF tweaks 0.4768/0.4743. All of these are within noise (sd 0.0070).
Next: replicate ErG first. Then tune the Ridge blend weight and alpha, and try other feature blocks such as MACCS. Read train.py before writing specs, since several slots were lost to aborts.
